zh: 龍淵閣。三教共審，被審的，是二十年來，江湖上最受敬重的人。
無涯佛者。太虛長老青松子，死於大日佛印之下。魏無憂與九霄，親眼所見。
阿彌陀佛。老衲沒有殺人。老衲能說的，只有這一句。
一句「沒有殺人」，就想抵一條命？
今天我就替青松子，討一個公道！
兩位少俠，在這裡流的血，不會讓死去的人，活過來。
殷閣主，三教共審，被告可有人代為辯白？
洛先生不屬三教……不過，九霄准了。
魏兄。那一夜，你看見佛者出掌。那一掌，是左手，還是右手？
白鶴道長，你與無涯相識四十年。他的大日佛印，用的是哪一隻手？
……右手。這老和尚，四十年來，從來沒有用左手出過掌。
慧明舉杯，用的也是左手。佛門弟子，佛者本人，一夜之間，都換成了左撇子？
也許，佛者正是要讓人這麼想。
大會之後，閣主也是這麼說燕姑娘的。每一個有破綻的地方，閣主都說，是兇手故意留的。
這樣一來，破綻越多，反而越像兇手。天下還有比這更好用的道理嗎？
哈……洛無塵這張嘴，貧道服了。
洛先生能言善辯，九霄佩服。可青松道長死了，這是事實。道門，總要一個交代。
九霄有一個兩全的辦法：真相大白之前，請佛者將佛門的封印，暫交龍淵閣保管。
無塵，老衲問心無愧。一道封印，換三教不起干戈，有何不可？
是什麼，老衲心裡明白。正因為明白，才要給。
佛者大德。九霄，代三教謝過。
洛無塵，左手右手，騙得過別人，騙不過我的眼睛。
魏兄，你的眼睛沒有錯。錯的，是你看見的那個人。
佛門的封印，交了出去。三道封印，此刻，全在一個人的手中。
恭喜閣主，三道封印，盡入囊中。
你那一掌，用錯了手。洛無塵差一點，就拆穿了你。
洛無塵越聰明，就越會替佛者辯白。他辯得越好，魏無憂，就越不信他。
……你這張臉後面，到底藏了幾層心？
劍譜，還在燕飛霜手裡。燕飛霜，在洛無塵身邊。
那就除掉洛無塵。三天之後，蓮心小築。本王、閣主，再加上，帝君的先鋒。
夜無極？……好。三個人，殺一個洛無塵，夠了。
我、我什麼都沒聽到！我是來……來收帳的！
收帳？好，本王就讓你，把命收回去。
……洛先生？這麼晚了，先生是來喝茶的？
茶是要喝的。不過無塵先要找一個人。錢不二，你偷了我的拂塵，跑到這裡來了？
是、是是是！小的該死！小的再也不敢了！
洛先生深夜來訪，是為了喝茶，還是為了救人？
先生可知道，這世上最危險的，是什麼？
是一個人，以為自己最聰明的時候。
三道封印，如今都在龍淵閣。先生，不擔心嗎？
封印鎖得住的，只是一本書。鎖不住的，是想打開它的那顆心。
那先生以為，九霄這顆心，鎖得住嗎？
閣主的心，要等閣主自己打開那本書的時候，才知道。
多謝閣主的茶。錢不二，走了。
洛無塵……三天之後，九霄親自，請你喝最後一杯茶。
洛先生，剛才那個殷九霄的眼神，好像要把我吃了……
洛無塵，本王等不了三天了。今夜，先試試你的斤兩。
鏡王親自出手，無塵不敢當。孤鴻。
他是來看孤鴻的劍，有多快。現在他知道了，三天之後，就會帶夠了人來。
洛先生，我都聽見了！三天之後，他們要在蓮心小築……殺你！殷九霄、千面鏡王，還有夜無極！
千面鏡王……殷九霄，真的和他是一夥的。
洛先生，我們現在就走！三對一，你不能留在這裡！
一個人，只有在他以為贏了的時候，才會把真心拿出來。殷九霄藏得太深，不讓他贏一次，他永遠不會翻開那本書。
無塵自有無塵的辦法。燕姑娘，三天之後，若是無塵不在了，妳打開這封信。
孤鴻，你過來。那一夜，你守斷橋。記住，無論看見什麼，都不要回頭。
偷？我錢不二，可是正正當當的生意人……偷什麼？
……什麼？！這要是被發現了，我會死的！
洛無塵要死了？哈哈哈，三個殺一個，這齣戲，本郎君可要買最前面的位子。
不過……他那種人，會這麼乖乖地死嗎？
有意思。本郎君倒要看看，這一局，到底是誰在騙誰。
借刀殺人，殺的是誰？借刀的人，又是誰？
三天之後，蓮心小築，一池白蓮，將染成紅色。
en: The Dragon Abyss Pavilion. The Three Teachings sit in judgment, and the one judged is the most honoured man the world has known in twenty years.
Buddha Wuya. Qingsong Zi, elder of the Void School, died beneath the Seal of the Great Sun. Wei Wuyou and I saw it with our own eyes.
Has the Buddha anything to say?
Amitabha. I did not kill him. That is all I am able to say.
One “I did not kill him” — and that’s to pay for a life?
Today I will have justice for Qingsong Zi myself!
Young masters, blood spilled here will not bring the dead back to life.
Pavilion Master — in a judgment of the Three Teachings, may another speak for the accused?
Master Luo belongs to none of the three... but very well. I allow it.
Brother Wei. That night you saw the Buddha strike. Was it his left hand, or his right?
Master Baihe, you have known Wuya forty years. With which hand does he strike the Seal of the Great Sun?
...His right. In forty years this old monk has never struck with his left.
Huiming lifted his cup with his left hand too. Did the Buddhist disciple and the Buddha himself both turn left-handed overnight?
Perhaps that is exactly what the Buddha wants us to think.
How familiar that sounds from the Pavilion Master’s lips.
After the council, the Pavilion Master said the same of Miss Yan. Wherever there is a flaw, the Pavilion Master says the murderer left it on purpose.
And so, the more flaws, the more guilty one looks. Is there any reasoning under heaven more convenient than that?
Ha... I give in to Luo Wuchen’s tongue.
Master Luo argues finely, and I admire it. But Master Qingsong is dead; that is a fact. The Taoists must have an answer.
I have a way that serves both: until the truth is known, let the Buddha leave the Buddhist seal in the Pavilion’s keeping.
Wuchen, my heart is clear. One seal to keep the three of us from war — why not?
It is not a seal you would be giving...
I know very well what it is. It is because I know that I give it.
The Buddha’s great virtue. On behalf of the three, I thank you.
Luo Wuchen, left hand or right — you may fool the others, but not my eyes.
Brother Wei, your eyes did not deceive you. The man you saw did.
The Buddhist seal was handed over. All three seals now lay in one man’s hand.
Congratulations, Pavilion Master. All three seals, in your purse.
You struck with the wrong hand. Luo Wuchen very nearly unmasked you.
This king did it on purpose.
The cleverer Luo Wuchen is, the harder he will defend the Buddha. And the better he defends him, the less Wei Wuyou trusts him.
...How many layers of heart do you keep behind that face?
One fewer than the Pavilion Master.
The manual is still in Yan Feishuang’s hands. And Yan Feishuang is at Luo Wuchen’s side.
Then remove Luo Wuchen. Three days from now, at the Lotus Heart Retreat. This king, the Pavilion Master — and the Emperor’s vanguard.
Ye Wuji? ...Good. Three of us for one Luo Wuchen will be enough.
I — I didn’t hear anything! I came to... to collect a debt!
A debt? Good. This king will let you collect — your life.
Pavilion Master — forgive a late call.
...Master Luo? So late — have you come for tea?
Tea, by all means. But first Wuchen must find someone. Qian Bu’er — you stole my whisk, and ran here?
Yes — yes, yes, yes! I deserve to die! I’ll never do it again!
My servant has been rude, and troubled the Pavilion Master.
Qian Bu’er — is Master Luo’s servant?
Does Master Luo come so late for the tea, or to save a man?
The tea is good. And the man is easy to save.
Does Master Luo know what is the most dangerous thing in this world?
A man at the moment he believes himself the cleverest.
Is Master Luo speaking of himself?
Wuchen is speaking of the two of us.
All three seals are in the Pavilion now. Is Master Luo not worried?
A seal can lock only a book. What it cannot lock is the heart that wants to open it.
And does Master Luo think my heart can be locked?
The Pavilion Master’s heart — we shall know it when he opens that book himself.
Thank you for the tea. Qian Bu’er — we’re going.
Luo Wuchen... three days from now, I shall pour you your last cup of tea myself.
Master Luo, the way Yin Jiuxiao looked at me just now — like he wanted to eat me...
It is not you he wants to eat.
Luo Wuchen, this king cannot wait three days. Tonight, let me take your measure.
The Mirror King himself — too great an honour for Wuchen. Gu Hong.
Mirror Light of Ten Thousand Forms!
...A fine sword. Three days from now, this king will learn more of it.
He — he’s gone? We’re all right?
He came to see how fast Gu Hong’s sword is. Now he knows, and three days from now he will bring enough men.
Master Luo, I heard everything! Three days from now they mean to kill you here at the Retreat! Yin Jiuxiao, the Mirror King — and Ye Wuji!
The Mirror King... so Yin Jiuxiao really is in league with him.
Master Luo, we leave now! Three against one — you can’t stay here!
It is my life they want.
Master Luo, what are you saying?
A man shows his true heart only when he thinks he has won. Yin Jiuxiao hides too deep; unless we let him win once, he will never open that book.
And you? What happens to you?
Wuchen has his own ways. Miss Yan — three days from now, if Wuchen is gone, open this letter.
Gu Hong, come here. That night, you hold the broken bridge. Remember: whatever you see, do not look back.
And me? What do I do?
You? You are going to steal something.
Steal? I, Qian Bu’er, am an honest businessman... steal what?
...What?! If they catch me, I’m dead!
Which is why: a hundred taels.
Luo Wuchen is going to die? Ha ha ha — three to kill one! For this show I’ll buy the best seat in the house.
But... would a man like that die so obligingly?
How amusing. I really must see who, in the end, is fooling whom.
A borrowed knife — but whose throat is it for? And whose hand borrowed it?
Three days from now, at the Lotus Heart Retreat, a pond of white lotus will turn red.
